related.title: Inception-v3：標籤平滑與機率質量
related.titleEn: Inception-v3: label smoothing and probability mass
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付二點分布表、模式切換與seed統計。；變異1.3333333與4正確，兩案期望2且eval無額外縮放。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver two-point distributions,mode switches and seed statistics.; Variances match,both means are2 and evaluation adds no scaling.
related.difference: 列四類完整target：.925,.025,.025,.025，標明真類別索引與歸約方式。；.925與.85正確，四類機率和1且平滑只套一次。
related.differenceEn: List all four targets:.925,.025,.025,.025,with true-class index and reduction convention.; Values match,probability sums1 and smoothing is applied once.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 反向縮放dropout為y=mask×x/(1−p)，E[y]=x，Var[y]=x²p/(1−p)。；教學x2，丟棄率p.25；改p.5，獨立Bernoulli遮罩。；Var=4×.25/.75=1.3333333；p.5時4。
採均勻混合目標q=(1−ε)onehot+ε/K，真類別qtrue=1−ε+ε/K。；教學K4,ε.1；改ε.2，這不同於只向錯誤類別分配ε的慣例。；qtrue=1−.1+.1/4=.925；改後.85。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Inverted dropout uses y=mask x/(1−p), preserving mean x with variance x²p/(1−p).; Teaching x2,drop probability.25 then.5,independent Bernoulli masks.; Variance=4×.25/.75=1.3333333; p.5 gives4.

Uniform-mixed targets are q=(1−epsilon)onehot+epsilon/K, giving qtrue=1−epsilon+epsilon/K.; Teaching K4,epsilon.1 then.2; this differs from distributing epsilon only over incorrect classes.; qtrue=1−.1+.1/4=.925; changed result.85.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Google TPU：脈動陣列填充與排空
related.titleEn: Google TPU: systolic fill and drain
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付二點分布表、模式切換與seed統計。；變異1.3333333與4正確，兩案期望2且eval無額外縮放。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver two-point distributions,mode switches and seed statistics.; Variances match,both means are2 and evaluation adds no scaling.
related.difference: 逐週期畫出輸入、乘加與輸出，說明短 K 為何降低陣列的時間利用率。
related.differenceEn: Draw input, MAC and output cycles to explain why short K reduces temporal utilization.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 反向縮放dropout為y=mask×x/(1−p)，E[y]=x，Var[y]=x²p/(1−p)。；教學x2，丟棄率p.25；改p.5，獨立Bernoulli遮罩。；Var=4×.25/.75=1.3333333；p.5時4。
簡化 M×N 陣列完成 K 次內積的週期為 K+M+N−2；理想時間利用率 K/(K+M+N−2)。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 M=N=8、K=32，假設每 PE 每週期一個 MAC，無記憶體停頓。 週期=32+8+8−2=46；利用率=32/46=69.5652%。這是波前模型，不是實際 TPU 效能。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Inverted dropout uses y=mask x/(1−p), preserving mean x with variance x²p/(1−p).; Teaching x2,drop probability.25 then.5,independent Bernoulli masks.; Variance=4×.25/.75=1.3333333; p.5 gives4.

A simplified M×N array takes K+M+N−2 cycles for K-term dot products; ideal temporal utilization is K divided by that count. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. M=N=8, K=32, one MAC/PE/cycle and no memory stalls. Cycles=32+8+8−2=46; utilization=32/46=69.5652%, a wavefront model rather than measured TPU performance.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
